notes.title: Additional Language Support (Italian)
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

With this update, No Case Should Remain Unsolved finally supports the [u][b]Italian language[/b][/u].
The Italian translation was done by [u][b]Giorgio Catania, Founder of Excaliber[/b][/u]([url=https://excaliber.it/]website[/url]).

Giorgio understood the overall content and atmosphere of the game, as well as the characterization of the individual characters, and helped me create an amazing Italian translation.
We really appreciate his hard work and enthusiasm.

I hope this update will bring the game closer to everyone who speaks Italian.

To everyone who loves NCSRU, thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Sincerely,
Somi

notes.title: I've got the Best Game Design Award at Tokyo Game Show 2024!!!
notes.content:
“No Case Should Remain Unsolved” was exhibited at the Tokyo Game Show 2024, held at Makuhari Messe in Tokyo from Sept. 26-30, 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/09c73073500c6c233bdb800333e6c9e9c91914dc.jpg[/img]

The Tokyo Game Show has a section called “Selected Indie 80” to support the exhibition of selected indie games, and has selected eight nominees out of more than 80 entries to present their games at an event called “Sense Of Wonder Night (SOWN),” where they will receive awards.

'No Case Should Remain Unsolved' was also selected as a nominee for the award, and on September 27, I gave a brief pitch for the game at a separate presentation site.

[previewyoutube=W2HERQmtF44;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm honored to announce that "Unsolved Case" won the award for Best Game Design, and I'd like to thank the judges for their selection, the attendees for their support during the pitch, and everyone I got to meet at TGS.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/5c6634e9410c6a0a7b6c1b16da5f900088db3acf.png[/img]

And the 'Unsolved Case'!
Nominated for the 'DISCOVERY AWARD' at 'SXSW Sydney 2024',
and nominated for 'BEST OVERSEAS GAME' at 'INDIEPLAY'!

Please look forward to the good news~!

Thank you!

notes.title: Additional Language Support (Spanish[Spain])
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Somi.
As promised, I'm working on making No Case Should Remain Unsolved available in more languages.

With this update, you can finally play NCSRU in [u][b]Spanish (Spain)[/b][/u]!
A big thank you to [b]Judit Jiménez Cuenca[/b], who asked a lot of questions about the context and meaning of the sentences and made the translation perfect.
I'd also like to thank [b]Paula Salguero Soto[/b], who meticulously went through the entire game and helped me with the proofreading.

For all those who were hesitant to play because of the lack of Spanish support, I hope you'll love the Spanish version of NCSRU.

Praying that every day is a happy one for you,
Sincerely, 
Somi

notes.title: Won 2 Awards at BIC Festival 2024!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

'No Case Should Remain Unsolved' has been honored with two awards at the BIC Festival 2024: 'Jury Prize' and 'Excellence in Social Impact'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/1990c2b20fe52c8728626ce2077f735ea97ac4bd.jpg[/img]

I exhibited 'No Case Should Remain Unsolved' at the 'Busan Indie Connect Festival 2024 (BIC Festival 2024)' held at BEXCO in Busan, Korea for three days from August 16th to 18th, 2024. I would like to express my sincere gratitude to everyone who came to my booth, said hello, and played the game.

At the awards ceremony held on the last day of the festival, 'No Case Should Remain Unsolved' was nominated for 'Excellence in Game Design', 'Excellence in Narrative', 'Excellence in Social Impact', and 'Jury Prize', and won the 'Jury Prize' and 'Excellence in Social Impact' awards. Super honored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/492dd4f4ed3e0e94d9797a6a70672608d0f8b364.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/d4be3448b493d24c3bd7f1cb3b4b58edb4f55d74.jpg[/img]

I'll be back at the Tokyo Game Show in September, and I'll see you there. See you soon.

Thank you.
Somi

notes.title: 'Excellence in Game Design Award' at the BitSummit!
notes.content:
[b]'No Case Should Remain Unsolved'[/b] won the [b]'Excellence in Game Design Award'[/b] at the [b]BitSummit[/b] in Japan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/29f1bef9f27b8f0fdbc7d08936f134eaded945ac.png[/img]

BitSummit, a Japanese indie game festival, was held in Kyoto, Japan, from July 19th (Fri) to 21st (Sun), 2024, and 'No Case Should Remain Unsolved' was an official selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/3403f14badfce26e31b14734e4afe39ae310c18f.jpg[/img]

To my honor, at the awards ceremony held on the 21st, [b]'NCSRU'[/b] won the [b]'Excellence in Game Design Award'[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/ab8d19e7c2cf10dd49caf475944a323401cfdcff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44737035/7bbd47041ba98da7357f7fbd06ff47249202de31.jpg[/img]

I'd like to sincerely thank everyone for their support, and especially honor 'Gon Lee' and 'Masa Kei' who did a great job with the Japanese translation.

Next up, I'm planning to participate in the upcoming BIC in Busan, South Korea in August. If you are planning to attend the event, please stop by Somi's booth.

Thank you.
Somi
